info.name: Robokalam Learner OS — Phase 1
info.description: Runs end-to-end: creates its own organization every run, so it can be re-run any time. Import the environment, then set BASE_URL, SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL and SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD. Scripts store AUTH_TOKEN, ORG_ID, LEARNER_ID, BATCH_ID, TEACHER_ID … in the environment as they go. Later phases (assignments, scores, badges, XP, CRM, WhatsApp) will be added to this collection as they ship.
